data.narrative:
Phantom Space is a Growth-stage space & aerospace company founded by Jim Cantrell, Michael D'Angelo, and Michal Prywata. The sector peer universe comprises 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private competitors including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard valuation triangulation methods are not applicable to Phantom Space given available data constraints. Peer-median analysis fails due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Space & Aerospace cohort—14 same-sector peers exist, but none satisfy the narrow filtering criteria requiring a minimum of 3 datapoints by stage or valuation tier. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be executed because target revenue is not on file; while the Space & Aerospace sector median P/S stands at 27.4x across the 6 public tickers, Phantom Space's private status and undisclosed financials preclude application of this method.

Without executable quantitative methods, a triangulated valuation range cannot be derived from this dataset. A complete valuation would require either Phantom Space's disclosed or estimated revenue figures to benchmark against public multiples, or access to internal financials and fundraising data sufficient to identify 3+ comparable private transactions at the same or adjacent stage. The primary uncertainty is opacity around the target's commercial traction and scale relative to the identified peer set.
